Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium collectible GOLD-tier achievement badge icon for CROSSBOUND, a cross-border trade exploration game.
Create ONE isolated, beautifully art-directed game badge. The existing UI is near-black petrol blue with electric-lime accents. Cohesive collection design: compact vertical chamfered octagonal medallion, warm satin champagne-gold metal rim with polished beveled edge, deep petroleum-green enamel inset, a strong sculptural national landmark emblem taking 60% of the face, one understated orbital trade-route curve behind it, small accurate national flag enamel inset centered at the top, three small gold stars embedded along the lower rim to communicate gold tier, engraved two-letter country code at the very bottom. Same outline and material language for all countries. Use only the specified country code as text.
Style: sophisticated 2.5D sculpted metal and vitreous enamel, crisp geometrical silhouette, carefully controlled highlights from upper left, elegant contrast, not grungy, not childish. Subtle object contact shadow only. Straight-on front view with slight visible bevel depth, perfectly centered, full badge visible, generously padded. Square canvas. Icon readable at 96px; choose a bold national silhouette rather than tiny clutter. Real transparent alpha background outside badge; no scene, no card, no presentation background, no checkerboard painted into image. No crown, ribbon, excessive laurel, giant gems, extra logos or watermarks.
Country subject: sculpted Merlion head and a compact Marina Bay Sands silhouette; a small Singapore flag enamel inlay (red upper half, white lower half, white crescent and five small stars in the red canton). Engraved text (verbatim): "SG".
